title: Limit reserve reads the source account's segment and portfolio through a read that goes to the replica

bugs.anchor: found, err := uc\.AccountRepo\.Find\(ctx, organizationID, ledgerID, nil, accountID
bugs.note: The grouping decides which spending limits the reserve is counted against, enforce mode included. Find is routed to the read replica and ignores the primary-read intent, so right after an account moves to another portfolio or segment a lagging replica returns the old grouping: the spend is counted against the old limit and the new one is not checked. An account not yet replicated reserves with no grouping at all.
